[[Daisuke Sakaguchi]]| }} '''Caserin''' (Japanese: '''カスリン''' ''Caserine'') and '''Luverin''' (Japanese: '''ラブリン''' ''Loverine'') are two {{p|Luvdisc}} that belong to {{an|Misty}} and her oldest sister {{an|Daisy}}, respectively. ==History== ===[[Pokémon Chronicles]]=== [[File:Misty and Caserin.png|left|thumb|220px|Caserin and Misty]] In ''[[HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!]]'', it was revealed that {{an|Misty}} and {{an|Daisy}} had both obtained Luvdisc of opposite [[gender]]s, in the hope of using them in one of the [[Cerulean City]] [[Gym]]'s water ballets. Caserin was in love with Luverin, but Luverin completely ignored Caserin's advances. Meanwhile, [[Dr. Namba]] had concocted an evil scheme to rid the world of love and needed the two Luvdisc as his key components. To his aid, [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]] were asked to steal the Luvdisc (in the original Japanese version, Dr. Namba only wanted them for his "R-project", not mentioning anything about ridding the world of love at all). His plans were ruined, however, when Caserin and Luverin were able to cooperate and save each other. Seeing Caserin's heroic acts, Luverin fell in love with him. Their mutual attraction finally allowed Daisy to complete her new show. {{left clear}} ==Personality and characteristics== Caserin was lovesick and easily saddened when Luverin would turn him down. However, with Misty's encouragement, Caserin was able to save both himself and Luverin, causing the latter to fall in love with him. ==Moves used== ===Caserin=== {{anmov/h|water||Caserin {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 6}}|0=Tackle|1=Water Gun|2=Ice Beam|3=Double Team|4=Luverin Agility 1|5=Luverin Agility 2}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 6}}|0=Tackle|1=Water Gun|2=Ice Beam|3=Double Team|4=Agility (Part 1)|5=Agility (Part 2)}}}} {{anmov|normal|Tackle|HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!}} {{anmov|water|Water Gun|HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!}} {{anmov|ice|Ice Beam|HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!}} {{anmov|normal|Double Team|HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!}} {{anmov|psychic|Agility|HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!}} {{anmov/f|water}} ===Luverin=== {{anmov/h|water||{{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Luverin Water Gun|1=Caserin Luverin Agility 1|2=Caserin Luverin Agility 2|3=Luverin Sweet Kiss}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Water Gun|1=Agility (Part 1)|2=Agility (Part 2)|3=Sweet Kiss}}}} {{anmov|water|Water Gun|HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!}} {{anmov|psychic|Agility|HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!}} {{anmov|normal|Sweet Kiss|HS16|Luvdisc is a Many Splendored Thing!}} {{anmov/f|water}} ==Trivia== * Caserin is Misty's first [[Generation III]] Pokémon. * Caserin is Misty's only Pokémon that: ** {{Ash}} has never encountered. ** Is [[nickname]]d. ** Has never been shown in her active party. * Caserin is the only non-temporary Pokémon belonging to a main character to have never appeared in the main series in any capacity. * Caserin is the first Pokémon Misty owns with a confirmed gender. * Caserin and Luverin's names are a play on both the name ''Catherine'' and the two syllables of ''Lovecus'', the Japanese name of Luvdisc.
